About.title: About Me
About.intro: A dynamic web developer and aspiring Solution Architect with hands-on experience building internal business operation systems.
About.description: Experienced in developing management dashboards, warranty workflows, inventory modules, permission-based systems, and AI-assisted operation tools. Comfortable working across frontend and backend, integrating REST APIs, collaborating with PMs and stakeholders, and translating operational requirements into maintainable software features.
About.full: Hello! My name is Nguyen Minh Quan (Quanngynx), a Software Engineer and Bachelor of Software Engineering student at Ho Chi Minh City University of Foreign Languages – Information Technology (HUFLIT). I have hands-on experience developing internal business operation systems at Quoc Bao Software Company, after-sales & warranty management platforms for LocknLock ASC operations, household appliance platforms for CORES, AI-powered IELTS e-learning systems, and agentic AI warranty operation tools (Servexa Warranty AI). My long-term goal is to become a Solution Architect capable of designing reliable, scalable, and business-aligned systems.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: A collection of web applications, enterprise systems, and AI-assisted platforms I've built.

items.title: Servexa Warranty AI
items.description: Agentic AI warranty operation platform for home appliance service centers. Features repair case management, RAG knowledge retrieval (PostgreSQL/pgvector), AI copilot assistance, and Human-in-the-loop approval workflows.

items.title: Customer Service & Warranty Platform
items.description: Internal after-sales service management system for LocknLock ASC operations. Supports repair case workflows, warranty processing, accessory inventory tracking, warehouse coordination, role-based permission control, and Excel/PDF reports.

items.title: AI-powered IELTS E-learning Platform
items.description: Internal IELTS e-learning platform featuring AI-powered feedback and personalized learning suggestions. Implemented 15+ responsive UI screens, TanStack Query caching, Redux Toolkit state management, SSR/CSR optimizations, and 20+ NestJS REST API integrations.

items.title: Home Appliance After-Sales Platform
items.description: Internal management system for household appliance after-sales service. Features inventory tracking, warranty activation, BigShop/partner account registration, user group management, and role-based permission control.

items.title: Quanngynx Portfolio
items.description: Modern interactive portfolio built with Next.js App Router, Framer Motion, Lenis smooth scroll, next-intl i18n, and Tailwind CSS.
